messages:
elaine: hey team, opened a PR to onboard aquila-13b (tokenizer normalization tweak + new 4-bit quant profile). planning to merge during tomorrow's merge window (10:00 PT). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/901 — can someone eyeball for compat and perf? cc @arjun @luis

arjun: on my list, thanks. will run the perf bench later today. can you call out expected latency delta in the PR desc so i know what to look for?

elaine: added perf notes to the PR: expect ~8-12% token latency increase on long sequences due to the extra normalization pass; quant profile should recover throughput in p99 workloads. also added perf graphs and raw numbers.

mike: i can take tokenizer rules. fyi we had some emoji-sequence failures in staging last week, worth double-checking.

ci-bot: ci/build — unit tests failed on main: tokenizer_unicode_tests.py::test_emoji_sequences (py3.10). logs: https://ci.redwood/inference/902/build/23 (looks like a flake)

luis: saw that one before, flaky on certain os locales. if you can add a deterministic test or NFKC step that should fix it. otherwise i'll rerun CI after you push.

elaine: pushed a small fix: explicit NFKC normalization before tokenization + added a deterministic emoji test to cover zero-width joiner sequences. PTAL. Also added a canary routing config to the PR so we can roll at 5% first. snippet in PR: ```json
{"route": "canary-aquila-13b", "traffic": "5%", "models": ["aquila-13b-q4", "aquila-13b-q4-fast"]}
```

jenna: routing looks fine to me, LGTM on the canary config. would like one more sign-off on the quant params from ML though. @arjun

arjun: reviewed the quant profile, left one minor comment about the temperature calibration default in the profile config (not blocking). overall numbers look reasonable.

mike: tokenizer patch looks good, small nit about a regex escape but not blocking. :+1:

luis: re-ran CI once the test was added, all green now. ci-bot shows successful builds.

ci-bot: ci/build — all checks passed for PR 901. merge allowed. https://ci.redwood/inference/902/build/24

elaine: awesome, thanks all. i'll merge at 10:05 PT tomorrow (slight buffer) unless anyone objects. will kick off the 5% canary and monitor logs/latency dashboards. ping me here if you spot anything odd after merge. :rocket:
